headline: Zoetis Appoints Jay Saccaro as Chief Financial Officer and Chief Operating Officer
summary: PARSIPPANY, N.J., August 06, 2026--Zoetis Inc. (NYSE: ZTS) today announced the appointment of James (Jay) Saccaro as Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer and Chief Operating Officer, effective August 17, 2026. In this newly created role, Mr. Saccaro will lead Zoetis’ global finance function, shaping capital allocation, financial strategy, reporting and controls, and investor engagement and oversee Global Manufacturing and Supply to drive operational execution and performance.
